name: occ-sorteio-evento-ta-em-casa
description: Sorteio de brindes para eventos da OCC (Tá em Casa)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.test: npm test -w backend && npm test -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
